description: A controlled attachment showing upload progress, processing, failure, cancellation and state-appropriate retry actions.

## Overview

Upload status presentation extracted from Kokobi. The host owns transport, real progress, cancellation, retry and finalization; rendering does not start a request. A completed upload and completed processing are separate states. See /docs/upload-attachment for examples, API reference and integration guidance.
